messages.content: What is the status and scheduled trial date for case number XY1234 in Los Angeles County Court, and case number GH5678 in Orange County Court?

function.name: court_info_get_case_status
function.description: Retrieves the status and trial dates for court cases from specified county courts. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

court.description: The county court where the case is filed.

details.description: Specific details required about the court case. Defaults to 'status'.

But maybe we can call with details unspecified to get default 'status'? But we need both status and trial_date. The function only returns one detail at a time. So we need to call twice per case: one for status, one for trial_date. That would be 4 calls. But maybe we can combine? The function signature says details defaults to 'status', but we can pass "trial_date". So we need two calls per case.

Thus we will call court_info_get_case_status for XY1234 in Los Angeles County Court for status, then again for trial_date. Then same for GH5678 in Orange County Court.
